corrections.correction: Tuck 1971 is a review of George F. MacDonald’s 1968 excavation monograph. It is not the original field report. Calibrated chronology here follows Lothrop et al. 2016 Table 3; firsthand observations use Stuckenrath 1964.

Debert 10,600 ± 47 radiocarbon BP is distinguished from its published 12,630 ± 135 cal BP summary. Labrador 7530 ± 140 BP and 8600 ± 325 BP remain unplaced without an independently verified calibration.

corrections.issue: A pooled date is not an occupation duration
corrections.correction: Debert’s displayed interval is the published 2σ summary translated from calendar BP, not an occupation lasting throughout the interval. The pooled suite count differs between the review and older accounts.
Cowpath’s legacy age is not copied to Cowpath East or Cowpath West. The combined Iceberg / Black Rock Brook sequence is not assigned as each site’s occupation span.

corrections.issue: Historical continuity and causation model overstated
corrections.correction: McGhee and Tuck’s proposed local development and possible environmental / Dorset-related change remain interpretive hypotheses, not demonstrated genetic continuity or single-cause displacement.

corrections.issue: Pacific comparisons presented as Atlantic evidence
corrections.correction: Pacific raised shorelines, submerged deposits, footprints, LIDAR screening and watercraft least-cost models do not establish an Atlantic migration route. Model scenarios and environmental opportunities remain distinct from observed human presence.
Use the primary conclusion’s 13,317–12,633 cal BP associated-wood envelope. The track-makers are a minimum of three individuals, not a resident population census.
Primary author CV and DOI metadata give pages 64–108; supplied 108–164 is not retained.
Original MA thesis, preliminary field report and later published chapter are separate works. The thesis year remains unresolved between 1984 and 1985 in accessed bibliographies.
